description: Accordion toggles, language-neutral: toggleValue(state, toggle) from core/src/accordion/state.ts, for a state whose expanded set is `value`. type defaults to single and collapsible to true. expect is the expanded set afterwards, in order. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.

toggles.name: Single: opening another closes the open one
Single and collapsible: the open section closes
Single, not collapsible: the open section stays open
Single, not collapsible: another section still replaces it
Multiple: opening adds the section at the end
Multiple: closing removes only that section
Multiple: the last open section closes, whatever collapsible says
